title: posixLock spins forever on a persistent flock error
description: Found while fixing withLock. posixLock retries flock(LOCK_EX) on any non-zero result, so a lasting error (e.g. EBADF) hangs instead of failing. Retry only on EWOULDBLOCK/EINTR or use blocking flock and check errno. Pairs with AB-3CBF11179470 (POSIX testing).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Persistent flock errors fail with a 'Cannot lock' error
